manifest.name: dsh-multi-superagent
manifest.author: DeepSeek Harness Team <team@dsh.dev>
manifest.description: Multi-SA: a multi-project Superagent DSH bundle. Each project listens to its own GitHub repository and optional Feishu bot, evaluates requests under its Policy, turns authorized ones into Tickets, and executes each in its own DSH Session.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

bundle.text:
# Multi-SA (dsh-multi-superagent) bundle layer: inserts the plugin and the agent presets its Sessions run under. Multi-SA runs
# one Superagent per project; each project mounts its own GitHub and optional Feishu Sources, so the bundle inserts no Source
# rows. The `dsh-multi-superagent` entry needs a root stateDir; projects live under <stateDir>/projects/<id>.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-multi-superagent
      name: dsh-multi-superagent
    # The agent preset of every Executor Session (WORKER_PRESET in src/app/sessions.ts); the main Session has its own, below.
    # It is DSH's `standard` preset with only what a worker needs, and a shell whose foreground command moves to a background job
    # after 5 seconds, so a long command does not hold back a person's message, which the Session takes at its next step. Left
    # out: questions to a person, presenting, plan mode, the plugin manager and market, scheduling, goals, workflows, web fetch,
    # and forked subagents, which would run under this preset; spawned subagents run under `standard`, whose shell moves a
    # command to a background job only after 60 seconds, as a subagent's jobs are killed when it ends. A preset row has no
    # setting that hides it from the preset picker, so its name and description say whom it is for.
    - id: dsh-multi-superagent-worker-preset
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-multi-superagent-worker
        name: Multi-SA 执行器
        description: Multi-SA 的执行器 Session 专用，不供手动选择。前台命令超 5 秒转入后台，只含执行工作所需的工具。
        order: 90
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          # A foreground command waits at most 5 s, then the shell tool moves it to a background job.
          - id: shell
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              shell: true
            config:
              - id: bash-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: pwsh-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: tool-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
              - id: tool-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          # A wait for a job ends after 5 s too; the job's end wakes the worker with its result.
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
            config:
              waitTimeoutMs: 5000
              maxWaitTimeoutMs: 5000
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelection: true
                  modelDiscovery: true
                  agentPreset: standard
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: false
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
    # The agent preset of the main Session (ROUTER_PRESET in src/app/sessions.ts). The worker's 5-second shell and job waits, so a command or a wait does not hold back the next candidates, and
    # only what the main Session uses: no subagents, web, file search or writes, todo list, questions to a person, presenting,
    # plan mode, plugin manager, scheduling, goals or workflows. No persona: the main Session's prompt is complete, so it has
    # no other section.
    - id: dsh-multi-superagent-router-preset
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-multi-superagent-router
        name: Multi-SA 主 Session
        description: Multi-SA 的主 Session 专用，不供手动选择。前台命令和任务等待超 5 秒转入后台，只含路由所需的工具。
        order: 91
        plugins:
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: shell
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              shell: true
            config:
              - id: bash-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: pwsh-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: tool-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
              - id: tool-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
            config:
              write: false
              edit: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
            config:
              waitTimeoutMs: 5000
              maxWaitTimeoutMs: 5000
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024

[中文](README.md) · [English](README.en.md)

> **仅供研究参考的原型，非 DeepSeek 官方产品。** 本仓库是在官方公开的 [dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype)（单仓 Superagent）之上做的**二次开发 / 衍生实现**，用于多项目隔离并行；与官方仓库无隶属或背书关系。代码来自团队日常开发，大量工程由 coding agent 完成。请当作研究代码，不要当成生产级软件；可能仍有缺陷，风格与工程实践也不统一。接入自己的环境前请先审阅并改写。
>
> 为公开做了适配，与内部版本及文章 *Exploring Super-agent Design: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System* 中的实现并不完全一致。文中部分设计属于后续方向，本原型尚未实现。上游单仓能力与缺陷请以官方仓库为准；本仓新增的多项目编排与隔离语义由本项目自行维护。

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1985790b-e8bb-4457-878e-0070fb652f6a

架构解说：Multi-SA 是 DeepSeek Harness 上的多项目、强隔离、可并行 Superagent（研究原型）。

官方 / 单仓 [dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype) 面向**一个** GitHub 仓库：一套 Sources、一套 Policy、一套执行上下文。实际工作里往往要同时推多个仓库（论文仓、产品仓、实验仓……）；若为每个仓各起一整套 Superagent，运维成本高，也容易串配置。

**Multi-SA**（包名 `dsh-multi-superagent`）在同一套 [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) 进程里托管**多个项目**，并保证彼此隔离、可并行：

- **一项目一仓库**：各自的 GitHub（可选飞书）、允许名单与规则
- **一项目一状态**：`~/.dsh/state/multi-sa/projects/<id>/`，面板与 API 按项目隔离
- **一 Ticket 一 Session / 工作目录**：并发执行时不共用 checkout，不串会话
- **统一运维入口**：一个独立 profile `multi-sa`、一口 `3084`、一套 `scripts/dsh-superagent` 管控启停与健康检查

它仍遵循 Superagent 的用法：**尽量少占人的注意力，尽量多交付有用结果。** 只在有人点名、或团队写好的规则允许时行动；只在必须有人出手、或结果值得看时说话。原则见 [docs/000-philosophy.md](docs/000-philosophy.md)。

readme.section: 和官方单仓 Superagent 比什么
readme.text:
| | 官方 / 单仓 `dsh-superagent` | Multi-SA（本仓） |
|---|---|---|
| 同时服务的仓库 | **1 个** | **多个**，可并行 |
| 配置与鉴权 | 全局一套 | **按项目隔离**（Sources / Policy / Execution） |
| Ticket 执行 | 单仓 Session / 工作树 | **每 Ticket 独立 Session 与工作目录** |
| 面板 | 单仓视图 | **按项目切换**，待办互不混排 |
| DSH profile | `superagent`（常见口 `3082`） | **独立** `multi-sa`（`127.0.0.1:3084`） |
| 状态目录 | `~/.dsh/state/superagent` | `~/.dsh/state/multi-sa` |
| 控制脚本 | 单仓仓内脚本 | 本仓 `scripts/dsh-superagent`（默认口 3084） |

readme.section: 和官方单仓 Superagent 比什么
readme.text: **不要**把 `dsh-superagent` 与 `dsh-multi-superagent` 装进同一个 profile：两者都会改进程级 `PATH` / git 设置，需要独立重启。部署细节见 [docs/006-deployment.md](docs/006-deployment.md) 的「独立 profile 部署」。

① 项目列表：一个 DSH 进程托管多个项目。每个项目有独立的计数、Agent 账号和状态目录，可单独进入、重启、停用或移除。

② 项目概览：标签按处理顺序排列：来源 → 触发 → 评估 → 执行。待人确认的 Ticket 可就地处理；24 小时漏斗显示到达、评估、接受的数量，以及执行器并发。

③ 评估：每条触发只得到一个决定，原因可追溯（例如「名单内的人明确请求，主 Session 接受」）。处理规则在 Policy 中配置。

④ 执行：每个 Ticket 有独立的 Session 与工作目录。可查看执行器状态、按生命周期筛选，并看到 Ticket 的阶段（如 CI 后等待新触发再唤醒）和人工介入点。

本地已有 DSH、模型与本仓检出时：

```sh

readme.section: 仅首次：建独立 profile 并挂上本仓
readme.text:
dsh multi-sa --from-default-profile web --dump-config > /dev/null
dsh plugin --profile multi-sa add "link:$PWD"

cd /path/to/multi-sa
scripts/dsh-superagent start
scripts/dsh-superagent status
```

面板链接在最新启动日志里的 `dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:3084/?token=…`。在面板里为每个仓库新建项目，再分别配 Sources / Policy / Execution。

Architecture explainer for Multi-SA: multi-project, strongly isolated, parallel Superagent on DeepSeek Harness (research prototype).

The official / single-repo [dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype) is built for **one** GitHub repository: one Sources setup, one Policy, one execution context. Day-to-day work often spans several repos at once (paper, product, experiments…). Spinning up a full Superagent per repo is heavy to operate and easy to misconfigure across instances.
**Multi-SA** (`dsh-multi-superagent`) hosts **many projects** in one [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) process, with isolation so they can run in parallel:

- **One project, one repository** — its own GitHub (optional Feishu), allowlists, and rules
- **One project, one state tree** — under `~/.dsh/state/multi-sa/projects/<id>/`; panel and APIs stay per project
- **One Ticket, one Session / work directory** — concurrent jobs do not share checkouts or sessions
- **One ops surface** — standalone profile `multi-sa`, port `3084`, and `scripts/dsh-superagent` for start / status / stop

It keeps the Superagent working style: **take as little human attention as possible, and give as much value as possible.** Act only when asked or when a team-written rule allows it; speak only when someone must act or can use a result. See [docs/000-philosophy.md](docs/000-philosophy.md).

| | Official / single-repo `dsh-superagent` | Multi-SA (this repo) |
|---|---|---|
| Repos served at once | **1** | **Many**, in parallel |
| Config & auth | One global set | **Isolated per project** (Sources / Policy / Execution) |
| Ticket execution | Single-repo Session / worktree | **Separate Session and work directory per Ticket** |
| Panel | Single-repo view | **Per-project switching**, queues stay separate |
| DSH profile | `superagent` (often port `3082`) | **Standalone** `multi-sa` (`127.0.0.1:3084`) |
| State dir | `~/.dsh/state/superagent` | `~/.dsh/state/multi-sa` |
| Control script | that repo's script | this repo's `scripts/dsh-superagent` (defaults to 3084) |

**Do not** load `dsh-superagent` and `dsh-multi-superagent` in the same profile: each changes process-wide `PATH` / git settings and needs its own restarts. See the independent-profile section in [docs/006-deployment.md](docs/006-deployment.md).
Screenshots of the local panel (`127.0.0.1:3084`). Project names, repositories, accounts, paths, and Issue / PR text are pixelated. Numbered color boxes mark the key parts (labels are in Chinese).

① Projects: one DSH process hosts many projects. Each project has its own counters, agent account, and state directory. You can open, restart, disable, or remove each one separately.

② Overview: tabs follow the flow: Sources → Triggers → Evaluation → Execution. Tickets that need a human can be handled in place. A 24-hour funnel shows arrived, evaluated, and accepted counts, plus executor concurrency.

③ Evaluation: each trigger gets exactly one decision, with a traceable reason (for example, "an allowlisted person asked explicitly; the main Session accepted"). Rules live in Policy.

When DSH, a model provider, and this checkout are ready:

```sh

readme.section: First time only: create the profile and link this checkout
readme.text:
dsh multi-sa --from-default-profile web --dump-config > /dev/null
dsh plugin --profile multi-sa add "link:$PWD"

cd /path/to/multi-sa
scripts/dsh-superagent start
scripts/dsh-superagent status
```

Open the `dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:3084/?token=…` URL from the latest start log. Create one project per repository in the panel, then configure Sources / Policy / Execution for each.
